column4: Skelecoll is a marine collagen supplement for joints, bones and muscles in the form of a ready-to-drink collagen shot, formulated by an orthopaedic surgeon and made in India. Each 30 ml bottle delivers 10,000 mg of hydrolysed Japanese marine collagen peptides (10 g of protein), pre-measured, with no collagen powder to mix and no tablets or capsules to count. WHAT IS IN IT. 13 actives, every dose printed on the label, no proprietary blends: marine collagen peptides 10,000 mg; glucosamine HCl 300 mg; hyaluronic acid 120 mg; calcium 250 mg with vitamin D3 600 IU; magnesium 50 mg; Cissus quadrangularis 500 mg; L-carnitine 1,000 mg; vitamin C 40 mg. WHAT ARE COLLAGEN PEPTIDES. Collagen is the most abundant protein in the body and the protein framework of bone, tendon, ligament and cartilage. Hydrolysed (also spelt hydrolyzed) collagen peptides are collagen broken into short chains that dissolve fully in liquid and are easy to digest, which is how a single small bottle carries 10 g of collagen. COLLAGEN FOR JOINTS. Skelecoll pairs the collagen peptides with glucosamine HCl and hyaluronic acid, a combination many joint formulas split across two or three products. It is made for adults who want to support joint comfort, flexibility and mobility, whether they walk, climb stairs, run, play sport or train in the gym. COLLAGEN FOR BONES. Collagen forms the framework that calcium and other minerals build on. Calcium 250 mg and vitamin D3 600 IU are included because bone mineralisation needs both. MUSCLES AND RECOVERY. Each collagen shot adds 10 g of protein to the day, and L-carnitine 1,000 mg supports recovery after exercise. TYPE 1 AND TYPE 2 COLLAGEN. Type 1 is the main collagen in bone, tendon, ligament and skin; type 2 is the main collagen in cartilage. Marine collagen is mainly type 1. Hydrolysed collagen peptides are digested into amino acids and small peptides that the body uses to build its own collagen. WHY MARINE COLLAGEN. Marine collagen comes from fish skin and contains no beef or pork. Bovine collagen comes from cattle hide. There is no true vegan collagen; products sold that way supply the nutrients the body uses to make its own. COLLAGEN DRINK VS TABLETS, CAPSULES OR POWDER. Studies of collagen peptides for joints mostly used 5 g to 12 g a day. A collagen tablet or capsule holds well under 1 g, so the same amount of collagen can mean a handful of tablets daily. Collagen powder reaches the dose but has to be measured and mixed every day. One Skelecoll shot gives 10,000 mg of collagen in a single sip, so the habit is easy to keep. FOR MEN AND WOMEN. The body makes less collagen as the years pass, for everyone. Skelecoll is a collagen supplement for men and women alike, from active adults in their thirties to people in their sixties. HOW TO CHOOSE A COLLAGEN SUPPLEMENT FOR JOINTS AND BONES. Check the grams of collagen per serving, the source (marine or bovine), whether glucosamine and hyaluronic acid are included, whether calcium comes with vitamin D3, and whether every dose is printed on the label. Skelecoll shows all of these on the box. BENEFITS OF MARINE COLLAGEN. The benefits people look for are easier movement, joints that feel comfortable through a long day, and support for bone strength over the years. Results build gradually with daily collagen use and vary from person to person. COLLAGEN PROTEIN. Collagen protein is rich in glycine, proline and hydroxyproline, the amino acids that connective tissue uses in large amounts, which makes collagen different from whey or plant protein. It complements a balanced diet rather than replacing a meal. COLLAGEN BOOSTER OR COLLAGEN. Some products sold as a collagen booster contain only vitamins, which help the body make collagen but supply none of it. Skelecoll gives the collagen peptides themselves. PAIRS WELL WITH. Regular movement, strength training and enough protein through the day. WHO IT SUITS. Active adults, people who spend long hours on their feet, regular walkers and gym-goers, and anyone who finds collagen tablets hard to swallow. Each sealed, single-serve collagen shot is easy to carry to work, the gym or on travel. HOW TO USE. Shake well and drink one 30 ml bottle a day, straight or mixed into water, before or after food, at any time of day. Cola flavour, sugar free, 40 kcal. Take your collagen daily for 8 to 12 weeks before judging the results, in line with how long the collagen studies ran. FOOD OR SUPPLEMENT. Bone broth and fish skin contain some collagen, but the amount varies widely and is hard to measure. A collagen dietary supplement gives a known amount every day, with no cooking or measuring. QUALITY AND SAFETY. This collagen supplement is made in an FSSAI-licensed, GMP-certified facility and lab tested. Contains fish and shellfish-derived glucosamine; not suitable for vegetarians or vegans. This is a food supplement. THIS PACK. Three boxes, 30 bottles of 30 ml: a full month at one bottle a day.
